ov: A genus of tiny Australian jumping spiders, mostly 4–5 mm long. To court a female, the male raises a brightly coloured, often iridescent flap on his abdomen and dances, waving his legs and sending vibrations. Females are drab and camouflaged.
rg: All species live in Australia; the area around Cape Riche in Western Australia is a hot spot for them.
fx: If a female is not impressed by the dance, she may attack, kill and eat the male.
Its blues come from nanostructures in its scales rather than pigment, and they do not fade over time.
